role: Senior Analytics Engineer - Cyber Data Platform
job_location: Welwyn Garden City, England, United Kingdom
responsibilities: Lead the implementation of data transformation pipelines and automated data quality frameworks, moving data across the raw, trusted and curated layers of the data platform to deliver reliable, scalable and trusted data products for security users.
Design, build and manage logical and physical data models that are discoverable, accessible and reliable to support various threat detection, analysis and reporting capabilities.

Drive engineering excellence by developing high-quality data pipelines and reusable solutions, producing clear documentation, conducting thorough peer reviews and proactively raising coding standards across the team through constructive feedback and knowledge sharing.

Implement automation practices that streamline the deployment, testing, monitoring and management of data models, pipelines and data quality frameworks, improving reliability, scalability and operational efficiency.

Support the design and adoption of analytics agents and conversational analytics capabilities that enable teams to explore and investigate security and business data using natural language, ensuring the responsible application of AI through appropriate governance, security controls and human oversight.

Develop and maintain trusted dashboards and visualisations that transform complex security and business data into clear, actionable insights, enabling self-service analysis, decision-making and data storytelling.

Partner with security, engineering and data teams to understand business needs, shape data product solutions and communicate complex data concepts effectively to audiences with varying levels of technical expertise.
I am also responsible for contributing to and supporting the recruitment, coaching and development of talent within the Cyber Analytics team.
